info.title: semantic-policy
info.description: The semantic-policy command: measures a policy's rules on a labelled dataset, sweeps thresholds against goals you set and compares providers, replaying a recording of their answers.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Evaluates a SemanticPolicy policy against a labelled JSONL dataset.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: samples
commands.description: Write the datasets, policies and recordings the tool ships with under a directory.

arguments.name: DIR
arguments.description: The directory to write them under; created when it does not exist.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Call the policy's providers on every row, record the answers, and report on them.

options.name: --policy
options.description: The policy file, in the library's JSON format.

options.name: --dataset
options.description: One dataset; tune and test halves come from metadata.split, when every row has one.

options.name: --tune
options.description: The tune dataset; goes with --test and excludes --dataset.

options.name: --test
options.description: The test dataset; goes with --tune and excludes --dataset.

options.name: --tune-split
options.description: The metadata.split value that marks a tune row. [default: tune]

options.name: --test-split
options.description: The metadata.split value that marks a test row. [default: test]

options.name: --where
options.description: Keep only rows whose metadata.<key> equals <value>; repeatable, and every filter must match.

options.name: --rule
options.description: The rule to evaluate; required when the policy has more than one.

options.name: --out
options.description: Write the JSON result to this file.

options.name: --record
options.description: Where the recording goes; ./<dataset>.<policy>.recording.jsonl when omitted.

options.name: --parallel
options.description: How many provider calls may be in flight at once. [default: 4]

options.name: --timeout
options.description: How long one provider call may take before it is recorded as a timeout. [default: 30]

options.name: --retries
options.description: How many times a call answered unavailable is made again, with a growing wait between. [default: 2]

options.name: --resume
options.description: Finish this recording: call the rows it lacks and the attempts it holds as unavailable, then rewrite it.

options.name: --providers
options.description: A providers file; its entries are then the only providers run may call.

options.name: --require
options.description: A rate the report must reach, or the verb exits 2: <rung>.min-precision=<v>, <rung>.min-recall=<v> or <rung>.max-fpr=<v> for a Boolean rule, min-accuracy=<v> or min-macro-f1=<v> for a Choice or Score rule, max-abstain=<v> or max-failure-rate=<v> for any, v from 0 to 1; repeatable, and every one must pass.

commands.name: sweep
commands.description: Sweep one binding's thresholds and margin gate on a recording, and recommend them under constraints.

options.name: --policy
options.description: The policy file, in the library's JSON format.

options.name: --dataset
options.description: One dataset; tune and test halves come from metadata.split, when every row has one.

options.name: --tune
options.description: The tune dataset; goes with --test and excludes --dataset.

options.name: --test
options.description: The test dataset; goes with --tune and excludes --dataset.

options.name: --tune-split
options.description: The metadata.split value that marks a tune row. [default: tune]

options.name: --test-split
options.description: The metadata.split value that marks a test row. [default: test]

options.name: --where
options.description: Keep only rows whose metadata.<key> equals <value>; repeatable, and every filter must match.

options.name: --rule
options.description: The rule to evaluate; required when the policy has more than one.

options.name: --recording
options.description: The recording to read.

options.name: --force
options.description: Read the recording even though the dataset's digest differs from the recorded one. [default: False]

options.name: --out
options.description: Write the JSON result to this file.

options.name: --provider
options.description: The binding to sweep, by provider name; required when the policy has more than one.

options.name: --warn
options.description: A constraint on the warn threshold: min-recall=<v>, max-fpr=<v> or min-precision=<v>, v from 0 to 1; repeatable, and the first one given decides which end of the feasible thresholds is recommended.

options.name: --escalate
options.description: A constraint on the escalate threshold: min-recall=<v>, max-fpr=<v> or min-precision=<v>, v from 0 to 1; repeatable, and the first one given decides which end of the feasible thresholds is recommended.

options.name: --deny
options.description: A constraint on the deny threshold: min-recall=<v>, max-fpr=<v> or min-precision=<v>, v from 0 to 1; repeatable, and the first one given decides which end of the feasible thresholds is recommended.

options.name: --gate
options.description: A constraint on the margin gate: max-abstain=<v> or min-accuracy=<v>, v from 0 to 1; repeatable, and the first one given decides which end of the feasible gates is recommended.
